Icons

An inline SVG icon system loaded from a sprite sheet. Icons scale to font size, inherit color, and support animation and multiple sizes.

Usage

Reference icons from the sprite with an SVG <use> element. The sprite is included in the CSS bundle — you just need to point at the correct symbol id (prefixed with #icon-).

html 
<!-- SVG sprite usage -->
<svg class="zak-icon">
  <use href="../../../../dist/icons/zak-icons.svg#icon-home"></use>
</svg>

<!-- CSS mask usage (color fully controlled by CSS 'color') -->
<i class="zak-icon zak-icon--home" style="color: red;"></i>

Sizes

Icons scale relative to the font size (em-based) or use fixed pixel sizes.

Sizes
xs
sm
md
lg
xl
2xl
css 
/* Em-based sizes (scale with font-size) */
.zak-icon-xs { width: 0.75em; height: 0.75em; }
.zak-icon-sm { width: 1em;   height: 1em; }
.zak-icon-md { width: 1.25em; height: 1.25em; }
.zak-icon-lg { width: 1.75em; height: 1.75em; }
.zak-icon-xl { width: 2em;   height: 2em; }
.zak-icon-2xl { width: 2.5em; height: 2.5em; }

/* Fixed pixel sizes */
.zak-icon-12 .zak-icon-16 .zak-icon-20 .zak-icon-24
.zak-icon-32 .zak-icon-48

Colors

Icons inherit the current text color by default. Use the zak-icon-* color utilities or the CSS mask approach for full color control.

Colors
html 
<svg class="zak-icon zak-icon-primary"><use href="#icon-star"/></svg>
<svg class="zak-icon zak-icon-success"><use href="#icon-check"/></svg>

<!-- CSS mask -- full control of color -->
<i class="zak-icon zak-icon--star" style="color: #f59e0b;"></i>

Animations

Add motion to icons with spin, pulse, and bounce animation classes.

Animations
Spin
Pulse
Bounce
html 
<svg class="zak-icon zak-icon-spin"><use href="#icon-refresh"/></svg>   <!-- rotate -->
<svg class="zak-icon zak-icon-pulse"><use href="#icon-bell"/></svg>     <!-- opacity -->
<svg class="zak-icon zak-icon-bounce"><use href="#icon-send"/></svg>    <!-- translate -->
<svg class="zak-icon zak-icon-shake"><use href="#icon-close"/></svg>    <!-- shake -->

Icon Buttons

Combine icons with buttons for compact, recognizable actions.

Icon buttons
html 
<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-icon zak-btn-primary" aria-label="Edit">
  <svg class="zak-icon zak-icon-16">...</svg>
</button>

<!-- Icon + text button -->
<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-primary">
  <svg class="zak-icon zak-icon-16"><use href="#icon-download"/></svg>
  Download
</button>

Accessibility

  • Decorative icons should be hidden from screen readers with aria-hidden="true" or focusable="false".
  • Meaningful icons must have a text alternative, either visible or via aria-label.
  • Icon-only buttons require an aria-label so the action is announced.
  • Prefer SVG sprites for icons over icon fonts, which have rendering and accessibility limitations.
  • Respect prefers-reduced-motion — disable decorative animations for users who request it.
